lessons.title: Biological Inspiration & The Perceptron
lessons.description: Trace biological neurons to Frank Rosenblatt's Perceptron, understanding weights, inputs, and the step threshold.

lessons.title: Activation Functions: Introducing Non-Linearity
lessons.description: Explore why non-linearity is vital. Compare Sigmoid, Tanh, ReLU, Leaky ReLU, and Softmax.

lessons.title: Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs)
lessons.description: Stack neurons into Input, Hidden, and Output layers to break linear separation limits like the XOR problem.

lessons.title: Forward Propagation in Action
lessons.description: Step through the matrix multiplications and activation vector calculations that transform inputs into predictions.
